annotations.title: 83(b) Election, QSBS and Delaware Franchise Tax Calculator

description: Computes the 83(b) filing deadline and tax on the grant, the federal tax saved by a QSBS (Section 1202) exclusion at a given sale price, and Delaware franchise tax under both methods. Federal tax only, top federal rates assumed, no state tax or AMT. Same math as https://modevc.com/tools/83b-qsbs-calculator. Illustrative model, not tax advice.

as_of_date.description: Date used for the days-to-deadline count. Defaults to today (UTC).

de_gross_assets.description: Gross assets in USD for the assumed par value capital method. Web default 750,000.
de_gross_assets.zeroNote: the web calculator replaces 0 with its default

de_par_value.description: Par value per share in USD. Web default 0.0001.

exit_stake_value.description: Sale value of your stake in USD for the QSBS comparison. Web default 15,000,000.
exit_stake_value.zeroNote: the web calculator replaces 0 with its default

fmv_per_share.description: Fair market value per share at grant in USD. Web default 0.0001.
fmv_per_share.zeroNote: the web calculator replaces 0 with its default

future_fmv_per_share.description: Assumed later fair market value per share, used for the tax a missed 83(b) would cost. Web default 2.50.
future_fmv_per_share.zeroNote: the web calculator replaces 0 with its default

grant_date.description: Date the shares were transferred, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today.

hold_years.description: Years the stock is held at sale. Web default 5.

issue_date.description: QSBS stock issue date, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to the grant date. Stock issued after 2025-07-04 gets the 50/75/100 percent steps at 3/4/5 years.

price_paid_per_share.description: Price paid per share in USD. Web default 0.0001.
price_paid_per_share.zeroNote: the web calculator replaces 0 with its default
